graphics.upscaling.mode.dx12: Streamline proxy swapchain persists; switching Off/FSR4/DLSS unloads one sl feature (sl.dlss / sl.fsr) and loads another, then re-tags color/depth/MV/exposure resources at the new feature's expected resolution via slSetTag. No swapchain recreation.
graphics.upscaling.mode.note: downgraded from Tier 1 vs. non-Streamline NGX/FFX raw integration

graphics.upscaling.fsr_preset.dx12: FSR4 quality preset changes internal render resolution scale -> resizes tagged input resources within the already-loaded sl.fsr feature context

graphics.upscaling.dlss_preset.dx12: DLSS 4.5 preset change reconfigures render-resolution scale within the loaded sl.dlss feature, no full context teardown

graphics.frame_generation.mode.dx12: DLSS-G / FSR4 frame generation load/unload as sl features through the same resident proxy swapchain. Allocates/frees interpolated-frame buffers and enables Reflex marker insertion, but presentation path itself (the proxy) is already in place from init.
graphics.frame_generation.mode.note: downgraded from Tier 1; still the most expensive Tier-2 operation since it also forces graphics.reflex on

graphics.frame_generation.multiplier.dx12: DLSS 4.5 multi-frame-gen (2x/3x/4x) changes the count of interpolated frame buffers allocated within the existing FG feature — resource count change, not a new feature load

graphics.reflex.dx12: sl.reflex is a Streamline plugin sharing the same proxy; toggling enables/disables low-latency marker insertion (slSetFeatureLoaded / slReflexSetMarker) rather than reinitializing an NVAPI pipeline from scratch
graphics.reflex.note: downgraded from Tier 1; forced to On automatically whenever frame_generation.mode != Off (cross-field rule still applies)
